subject: [PATCH v9 22/32] mm/madvise: free PMD swap entries with MADV_FREE

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the MADV_FREE behavior in Linux to free PMD swap entries when the advice covers the whole PMD, rather than only freeing individual PTEs. This change ensures that userspace gets the expected result from MADV_FREE over a swapped-out THP. The patch also moves the zap_deposited_table function above its new caller and makes no other changes to it.
